title: Operating Imperfect AI: Reliability Drift and Human Congestion
summary: The deployment of machine learning in high-stakes services relies on ``human-in-the-loop'' architectures to mitigate algorithmic uncertainty. However, existing static policies fail to address a fundamental tension: algorithms suffer from stochastic ``reliability drift,'' while human override capacity is scarce and congestible. We formulate the management of such systems as a dynamic queueing control problem.
